templates.title: Message templates
templates.help: Write the body of message notifications. Leave a field empty to keep the default.
templates.markdownNote: This channel sends Markdown: text from the mesh is escaped, your own Markdown in the template is kept.
templates.plainNote: The preview shows Markdown as is; a real message escapes text from the mesh.

errors.template_too_long: A template is limited to {{max}} characters.
errors.template_invalid: This template is not valid (control characters are not allowed).
errors.template_unsupported: This type of channel does not take message templates.
